_what: One query per served skill, phrased as a PERSON states the job — never the skill's name, never a phrase lifted from its summary or description. A skill passes when find_skills ranks it in the default top 5, and the ratchet beside this (find_skills_rank_baseline.json) says which are not ranked FIRST. Authored 2026-09-19 from flo2 F8 ('the only way to find a skill you cannot name is to read all 29 descriptions') and the owner's own line, 'I continually forget which skills are available'.

queries.adopt: we already have a working codebase with nothing written down, get it under control
queries.brainstorm: I am just thinking out loud, do not turn any of this into commitments
queries.capture-intent: here is a new feature I want, write it down properly
queries.capture-session: save what we decided in this conversation before I close it
queries.check-health: we changed the structure, is anything now broken or inconsistent
queries.ci-gate: make the build fail when the code no longer matches what we designed
queries.detect-and-ask: what open questions do I still need to answer
queries.establish-taxonomy: before we add fifty of these, decide how each kind gets recorded
queries.feedback: what should I send upstream about how this tool behaved for us
queries.genesis: start a brand new design from my first description of the thing
queries.governance-proposal: we have a rule everyone must follow, write it down and say whether breaking it blocks the build
queries.help: what is this and how do I begin
queries.impact-check: if I change this, what else does it affect
queries.ingest-corpus: load this folder of documents into the design with provenance
queries.kpp-proposal: there is a hard limit we must never break, record it
queries.link-artifacts: I wrote the file, register it against the part it implements
queries.link-ideas: these thoughts are sitting on their own, join them up with what they belong to
queries.link-projects: make two separate designs work together across their boundary
queries.log-issue: jot down something to come back to later, one line
queries.onboarding: I am new to this design, where does my piece of work belong
queries.optimize: make this faster or cheaper against a budget we write down first
queries.parallel-work: several of us are on the same design at once without stepping on each other
queries.plan-increments: what should we build next and in what order
queries.report-friction: something in reflow2 itself is broken, tell its maintainer
queries.retire-from-design: take this thing out of the design but keep why it was there
queries.revise-design: change something already in the design without losing the old version
queries.root-cause: find why this failed before we fix the symptom
queries.topic: everything we have written down about batteries, all in one place
queries.triage-feedback: work through this field report the way the rules require
queries.where-am-i: where does the design stand right now, in my own words
